يتشاعر (form VI)
# يَتَشَاعَرُ (yatašāʕaru) /ja.ta.ʃaː.ʕa.ru/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of تَشَاعَرَ (tašāʕara)
# يَتَشَاعَرَ (yatašāʕara) /ja.ta.ʃaː.ʕa.ra/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of تَشَاعَرَ (tašāʕara)
# يَتَشَاعَرْ (yatašāʕar) /ja.ta.ʃaː.ʕar/: third-person masculine singular non-past active jussive of تَشَاعَرَ (tašāʕara)
